outsideMoney: Commission is paid directly between the parties, outside getproperty. The platform only records the amount from the mandate terms and never deducts it from rent.

scopeHint.list: The agency may list this unit
scopeHint.list_and_lease: Lists the unit and sees its leases
scopeHint.manage: Sees the unit's listing, leases, invoices and service requests

mandates.title: Agency mandates
mandates.ownerDescription: Ask an agency to list or manage your units. An agency sees only the units you mandate, and you can revoke at any time.
mandates.agencyDescription: Owners who mandated units to you. Once you accept, you see the unit and can list it.
mandates.emptyOwnerHint: Invite an agency to help find a renter for a vacant unit.
mandates.inviteTitle: Invite an agency to a unit
mandates.inviteHint: The agency sees only this unit once it accepts. You can revoke at any time; getproperty charges nothing for it.

fields.agencyHint: Type the agency's name to search
fields.exclusiveHint: No other agency may hold a mandate on this unit at the same time
fields.commissionHint: When both are given, the fixed amount applies

mandates.acceptBody: {scope} · {exclusive} · {commission} from {owner}. Once accepted you see this unit and can list it.
mandates.declineBody: The owner will see that you declined.
mandates.revokeTitle: Revoke the mandate for unit {unitNo} from {agency}
mandates.revokeBody: The agency loses access to this unit at once and its listing of the unit is closed.
mandates.endBody: Access to this unit ends at once and the agency's listing of the unit is closed.

units.title: Mandated units
units.description: Units owners mandated to you. You see only these units; access ends when the owner revokes or the mandate ends.
units.emptyHint: When an owner invites you and you accept, the unit appears here.
units.welcome: Welcome — your agency account is ready. Free, with unlimited users, units and listings.

coBroke.title: Co-broke
coBroke.description: Commission-sharing agreements with other agencies for listings you hold, or that other agencies invited you to.
coBroke.proposeHint: The co-agency signs in getproperty before it applies. The share is computed from the commission recorded when the deal closes.
coBroke.noListings: You need a listing of a mandated unit before you can propose co-broke.
coBroke.signBody: You get {percent} of the commission when listing {slug} closes a deal. Your name and the time are recorded.
coBroke.cancelBody: The co-agency can no longer sign this proposal.
coBroke.endBody: Deals closed after this are not shared under this agreement.

deals.title: Closed deals
deals.description: Leases signed through getproperty whose first rent payment is confirmed, with the commission recorded.
deals.emptyHint: A deal appears once a lease is signed in getproperty and the first rent is paid.
deals.feesHint: Billed on your getproperty invoice, never deducted from rent.
deals.noFees: No fee for this deal (no price set yet).

signUp.subtitle: Agency accounts are free, with unlimited users, units and listings.
signUp.name: Agency or agent name
signUp.nameHint: The name owners see when they mandate a unit
signUp.asLandlord: Own a unit? Sign up as an owner
